scope: XL02 single-writer mirror consistency and HDFS recovery policy

tests.skip: Existing Windows symlink-creation permission case; Linux CI executes it

verified_behaviors: Restart and explicit recovery reject missing/empty metadata with local data, unlisted payloads, missing files and later corrupt mirrors before any dataset upload
Duplicate metadata keys and empty digest-bound payloads fail closed
Interrupted second upload preserves local verified bytes and degraded state; restart retries complete inventory
Read-back comparison uses at most 1 MiB plus 1 byte and prevents activation on mismatched bytes
Uncommitted atomic candidates are ignored, retained and never uploaded
Strict HDFS runtime failures never fall back or mutate local mirror data
real_hdfs_integration: Separate exact-commit Linux CI job exercises actual Hadoop stop/start, inventory restart denials, unchanged server-side canary, replay and browser states. Native fault adapters do not count as real HDFS proof.
limits: Single managed writer; preflight is fail closed, not an atomic multi-file transaction. Failed remote uploads may change HDFS before retry. No background repair, concurrent external-writer merge, native service-runtime proof, fair benchmark, measured WAN, ML quality or full v1 release claim.
